answer: Each agent anchors its key in a scarce secure element, and every payment lands on a ledger terrace where identities are ranked by accrued stake. New identities begin with zero history, and reputation accrues only through verifiable work. Minting thousands of agents buys nothing: they arrive unfunded and untrusted, and climbing the tiers costs real computation per seat. Attacker cost scales with swarm size while payoff stays flat. Gates stay shut from the first dawn until a real record accrues, and the ferrous attestation in each device makes forgery harder than buying more keys.
